sourceTitle: Butter Pecan Icecream with Apples and Chocolate Chips
sourceText:
Butter Pecan Icecream with Apples and Chocolate Chips
By: Chef Sowmya
Published: Thursday, August 1, 2013 - 1:42pm

Ingredients




Butter Pecan Icecream- 2 scoops
1/2 an apple cubed
1 graham cracker crumbled
Chocolate Chip cookies
Low fat whip cream

Preparation

1 Scoop icecream into a bowl 2 Add a layer of apples with graham cracker crumble 3 Add some chocolate chips over it 4 Top it off with a nice little whipcream cone! 5 Voila! Enjoy before it melts!

About

Delicious Butter Pecan icecream with chocolate chips, apples and graham crackers
